text:
Samir: Quick follow-up from the authz postmortem — splitting actions here to get owners and timelines.
Maria: Thanks — adding notes. I'll own token validation fix and RFC for tolerant parsing.
Devon: I'll pair on token tests. ETA for unit+integration tests: 2 weeks.
Samir: @Maria + @Devon, please confirm blockers. We need rollback-safe rollout.
Maria: Plan: fix validation logic -> add schema tests -> canary rollout to staging -> monitor audit events. Target: 2026-04-06.
Taylor: I'll update perms matrix and add CI check for least-privilege roles. Assigning to me, due 2026-03-30.
Priya: I'm going to schedule a run of the audit log replay to validate missing entries — starting tomorrow. :eyes: 
security-bot: [automated] New task created: SEC-4572 'token-validation-regression' assigned to Maria, due 2026-04-06.
Samir: Couple of quick followups: secrets rotation checklist needs runbook, and we need to verify KMS access logs.
Maria: Drop the secret rotation runbook draft here:
```
- rotate secrets monthly
- update consumers with rollout token endpoint
- verify access logs in KMS for rotation window
- post-rotation smoke tests
```
Devon: For rollout, recommend using feature flag + max request rate limiter to avoid cache thrash.
Taylor: I'll add a monitor in console for 'authz.failure_rate' and a dashboard for 'audit.missing_events'.
Samir: Owner/timeline summary: Maria (token validation + runbook) due 2026-04-06; Taylor (perm checks + monitor) due 2026-03-30; Devon (tests + rollout safety) due 2026-04-06; Priya (audit replay) due 2026-03-28.
Maria: I'll post PRs to infra and add evals to Redwood Optimize harness.
Devon: Will add test harness to eng-runtime repo and ping @Samir when ready.
Samir: Great — I'll kick off a short check-in next Wednesday. If anyone hits a blocker ping #incidents-ops.
Priya: noted, leaving audit replay running now. :white_check_mark:
Taylor: added dashboard draft, sharing link: https://console.redwood.internal/dashboards/authz-audit (internal)
Samir: Thanks all. Closing thread — keep updates in the task SEC-4572 and status channel. :thumbsup:
